programs.title: American Loggers
programs.desc:
In this series, we meet the Pelletier family - nine brothers who have to deal with the harsh nature, equipment failures and everyday squabbles so that their company, Pelletier Inc., can function smoothly.This company is the embodiment of the American dream.50 years ago, Gerald Pelletier founded it on his own, with one truck and $100.Currently, his sons run a large corporation that employs dozens of workers and uses hundreds of machines to cut down thousands of hectares of forest.
When the downpours finally end, it's time to transport the wood to the sawmill.Pelletier Inc.is late with the weekly plan, so Eldon, at great risk, sets off on the Golden Trail in a truck with an additional trailer.The man is determined and wants to prove that it is possible.Meanwhile, David McLaughlin has had a lot of bad luck lately.First, his equipment failed, and then he himself came close to death while driving his tractor.A few days later, a fire breaks out in his house.The Pelletiers try to help their friend, but the resulting delay brings another financially disastrous week.
